snippet.title: Pungo Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Indie Video Game made in Argentina

Two cats, a ball of yarn, and a duel full of reflexes and fun. Play against a friend or solo, use surprising power-ups, and unlock adorable kittens. Will you be the most agile on the field? Catch the yarn ball and show off your skills in Pungo!

Coming soon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603010/Pungo/
